categoriesManager.aiDescription: Describe your company, industry, or product to get AI-suggested categories tailored to your business.
categoriesManager.aiPlaceholder: e.g., We are an airline company offering domestic and international flights. Our customers care about punctuality, comfort, baggage handling, customer service, and in-flight experience...
categoriesManager.generateError: Failed to generate categories. Please try again.
categoriesManager.emptyHint: Use AI generation above or add categories manually below.
categoriesManager.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this category and all its subcategories? This action cannot be undone.
categoriesManager.listHelp: Each category has an id stored on every review, a description, the product it belongs to, and its product owners. Owners automatically see their categories' feedback and are the people who act on it.
categoriesManager.saveError: The categories could not be saved. Check the names and limits, and that you are an administrator.

details.productHint: The product or area this category belongs to.
details.ownersUnavailable: The user list could not be loaded, so owners cannot be added right now.
details.ownersHint: Owners automatically see this category's feedback.

reprocess.title: Reprocess existing feedback
reprocess.description: After changing categories, re-categorise the reviews already stored. Reviews are updated in place — nothing is deleted.

processed.title: Re-categorise processed reviews
processed.description: Classifies the stored (translated) text against the current categories. Only category and subcategory change.

raw.title: Reprocess from raw data
raw.description: Re-runs the full enrichment (sentiment, category, persona, problem analysis) from the original raw data.

dimensions.title: Re-infer dimensions
dimensions.description: Re-runs the model for the dimensions it may infer. Values set by the source, its profile or a person are never changed.

reprocess.alreadyRunning: A reprocess job is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
reprocess.stoppedAtCeiling: Stopped at the per-job limit of {{max}} reviews to cap model costs — the remaining reviews were not reprocessed. Narrow the window to cover them.
reprocess.startError: The reprocess job could not be started.
reprocess.daysHint: 1–{{max}} days, or 0 for all time. Manual corrections are kept unless you choose otherwise.
reprocess.costNote: Cost: one model call per review in the window. An all-time run over a large data lake can take hours.
reprocess.confirmMessage: {{mode}} for {{window}}. This makes one model call per review in that window. Reviews are updated in place; nothing is deleted.

dataSourceWizard.dataSourcesDescription: Select what data to use for generating the document
dataSourceWizard.leaveEmptyForAllDocuments: Leave empty to use all documents
dataSourceWizard.leaveEmptyForAllPersonas: Leave empty to use all personas
dataSourceWizard.leaveEmptyForAllResearch: Leave empty to use all research

errorBoundary.description: This page hit an unexpected error. You can reload it or go back home — the rest of the app is unaffected.
errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.notFoundDescription: This address doesn't match any page. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.

formQrCode.title: QR code
formQrCode.unavailable: QR code unavailable until the API endpoint is configured in Settings

prototypeLink.linkExpiryHint: tied to your session, not a share link

s3Import.dropFiles: Drop files here or click to upload
s3Import.unsupportedFile: Unsupported file type: {{filename}}. Only CSV, JSON, and JSONL files are supported.

socialFeed.noFeedback: No feedback found for this period

userAdmin.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete {{email}}? This cannot be undone.
userAdmin.confirmDisable: Disable {{email}}? They will not be able to log in.

userAdmin.loadError: Failed to load users. Make sure you have admin access.
userAdmin.noUsers: No users found. Add your first user above.

categoryAccess.title: Category access
categoryAccess.adminNote: This user is an administrator and always sees every category, whatever is saved here.
categoryAccess.ownersNote: Product owners always see their own categories, even if they are not selected here.
categoryAccess.saveError: Category access could not be saved.
categoryAccess.loadError: Category access could not be loaded.

flags.title: Memory & ownership flags
flags.description: Memory reviewers curate company memory. The fallback owner (one admin) receives agent-created projects whose category has no owner.
flags.fallbackAdminOnly: Only an admin can be the fallback owner.
flags.saveFailed: Could not update the flag. Try again.

sourceAccess.title: Sources
sourceAccess.default: Every source that is not restricted (default)
sourceAccess.noProfiles: No source profiles are configured yet (Administration → Sources & privacy).

errors.invalid: That category no longer exists. Refresh and pick another.
errors.notFound: This review is not available to you, or the category is outside your access.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this review at the same time. Refresh and try again.
errors.generic: The category could not be changed.

unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.message: You have changes that are not saved. Save them before you leave, or discard them?
unsavedChanges.saveFailed: Could not save. Your changes are still here; try again or cancel.
unsavedChanges.cannotSave: Fix the highlighted problems before saving, or discard the changes.

dimensionFields.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas or semicolons (up to 20).
dimensionFields.tagsInvalid: Not allowed (no "#", "," or ":", at most 64 characters): {{tags}}
dimensionFields.sourceHint: Decides the personal-data policy, retention, visibility and default dimensions of these rows.
dimensionFields.sourceRestrictedHint: Restricted: only admins and people granted this source will see these rows.
dimensionFields.defaultsHint: Every review from here carries these values; its own values win per dimension.
dimensionFields.noDimensions: No dimensions are configured yet (Administration → Dimensions).

dimensionsManager.parentOfChildren: Parent of {{children}}, so it cannot have a parent itself.
dimensionsManager.parentHint: A child narrows its values by the parent's value (one level only).
dimensionsManager.inferHint: Off: only the source, its profile or a person sets it.
dimensionsManager.emptyHint: Add one to tag feedback by product, module, user type or anything else.
dimensionsManager.loadError: The dimensions could not be loaded.

problems.keyFormat: Key "{{key}}": use lowercase letters, digits and "_", starting with a letter (up to 32).
problems.labelLength: The label of "{{key}}" is longer than {{max}} characters.
problems.descriptionLength: The description of "{{key}}" is longer than {{max}} characters.
problems.parentInvalid: "{{key}}" must name another top-level dimension as its parent.
problems.parentValueMissing: Value "{{value}}" of "{{key}}" belongs to a parent value that no longer exists.
problems.valueFormat: Value "{{value}}" of "{{key}}": 1-64 characters, no spaces, "#", "," or ":".

sourcesManager.retentionHint: {{min}}-{{max}} days. A daily job deletes older reviews of this source and their raw archives.

pii.allowHint: Text, author and title are stored as the source sent them.
pii.redactHint: Emails, phone numbers, IBANs, card numbers and IP addresses are replaced before storage; the author is dropped; no raw copy is kept.
pii.summaryOnlyHint: Only derived fields (summary, category, sentiment, dimensions) are kept; the original text is withheld.

sourcesManager.restrictedHint: Only admins and users granted this source in Users → access see its reviews.
sourcesManager.defaultsTitle: Dimension values for every review from this source
sourcesManager.empty: No profiles yet: every source keeps everything, forever, visible to everyone.
sourcesManager.loadError: The source profiles could not be loaded.
sourcesManager.addHint: Pick a plugin, feedback_form or manual_import, or type an import source id such as sales_csv.
sourcesManager.scraperHint: A web scraper's reviews carry the scraper's name as their source id, so only a scraper named in this format (lowercase letters, digits, _ or -, for example trustpilot_reviews) can have a profile.

problems.retention: {{name}}: retention must be {{min}}-{{max}} days, or keep forever.
problems.idFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, "_" or "-" (up to 48).
problems.idDuplicate: That source already has a profile.

erasure.title: Erase one person's feedback
erasure.description: Deletes every matching review and its raw archive. This cannot be undone. Only a hash of the value is kept.
erasure.sourceRequired: An id is unique only within its source: choose the source.
erasure.confirmMessage: Every review whose {{field}} matches the value ({{source}}) and its raw archive will be deleted permanently.

errors.invalid: That dimension value or tag is not allowed.
errors.notFound: This review is no longer available.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this review at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.generic: The change could not be saved.

feedbackDimensions.redactedHint: Personal data in this review was replaced before it was stored.
feedbackDimensions.summaryOnlyHint: Its source keeps only derived fields; the original text was not stored.
